value.rationale: Betweenness and eigenvector centrality are canonical but conceptually different social-network ranking measures: brokerage/control versus recursive prestige/visibility. A sharp smallest graph at which their unique top-ranked actors disagree is a natural interpretability boundary, and the complete seven-type onset classification supplies minimal benchmarks for comparing implementations and substantive interpretations.
